test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The two old queens are signing the treaty today.

options.text: The treaty is signing by the two old queens today.
The treaty is going to be signed by the two old queens today.
The treaty is being signed by the two old queens today.
The treaty is signed by the two old queens today.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

 
• In the original sentence, "The two old queens are signing the treaty today", the verb "are signing" shows an ongoing present action.
